newsitem.title: UK: Enterprise at new high, talk of US briefing.
newsitem.headline: Enterprise at new high, talk of US briefing.

text.p: Shares in Enterprise Oil Plc jumped to a new record high on Wednesday as briefings to U.S. fund managers by executives from the oil exploration group sparked renewed investment demand, dealers said.
By 1445 GMT Enterprise shares were up 14p to 696-1/2 in volume of 2.1 million shares. Earlier it hit a new all-time-high of 702p, surpassing the previous record of 697-1/2p set on January 31.
"There was much demand from institutions overseas", one trader said. At Enterprise nobody was immediately available for comment.
Separately Enterprise was among companies awarded licenses to drill for oil off the Irish west coast, but traders said they doubted that the news had an impact on the stock.
